# Savills Vietnam

> > Premier real estate services in Vietnam, specializing in luxury residential sales and commercial office leasing across Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi.

Savills Vietnam is the leading international real estate advisor in Vietnam, offering comprehensive property services including Grade A and B office leasing, luxury residential sales in premium developments like The Nassim, The Marq, and The Albany, and market expertise across key districts in HCMC and Hanoi. The platform features properties from top developers including SonKim Land, HongKong Land, and Vinhomes.

## Key Topics

- Commercial office leasing
- Luxury residential sales
- Grade A and B office buildings
- Ho Chi Minh City (HCMC) properties
- Hanoi real estate market
- District 1 CBD offices
- Thao Dien luxury residences
- Mixed-use developments
- SonKim Land projects
- HongKong Land developments
- Vinhomes residential communities
- Phu My Hung District 7
- Thu Thiem urban area
- Property investment Vietnam
- International property standards
